executive_summary: Maven compilation failed due to 43 missing dependency errors. Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, Jakarta Persistence, and Apache Commons Lang3 packages are not available on the classpath. Add the missing dependencies to pom.xml to resolve all compilation errors.

errors.root_cause: Spring Security dependency is missing from pom.xml. Multiple security-related packages cannot be found including HttpSecurity, SecurityFilterChain, and EnableWebSecurity.
Spring Data JPA dependency is missing from pom.xml. JpaRepository, Query, Modifying, and Param annotations are not available. This affects ColumnRepository, TaskRepository, and UserRepository.
Jakarta Persistence API is missing. Entity, Table, Id, and other JPA annotations cannot be resolved. This is typically included with spring-boot-starter-data-jpa.
errors.fix_recommendation: Ensure spring-boot-starter-data-jpa is added to pom.xml as it includes Jakarta Persistence API. If already added, verify the Spring Boot version supports Jakarta namespace (3.x+).

errors.root_cause: Apache Commons Lang3 library is missing from pom.xml dependencies.
